nina: Noticed the Go SDK is dropping the REST param `batching_hint` when callers use `BatchHint` in struct literal. Sample app throughput regressed. :grimacing:
carl: can you paste the tiny repro?
nina: yes — REST respects `batching_hint` and `max_batch_size` but SDK payload ends up with defaults.
nina: ```bash
# REST (respects batching_hint)
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -d '{"model":"redwood-s","batching_hint":0.9,"max_batch_size":32,"inputs":["a","b"]}'

# Go SDK (silently drops it)
client.Generate(ctx, GenerateOptions{Model: "redwood-s", Inputs: []string{"a","b"}, BatchHint: 0.9, MaxBatchSize: 32})
```
ops-bot: quick log check (req=01AAA111): wire payload observed `{max_batch_size:8}` not 32.
nina: also saw a weird auth-retry interaction: sampleapp retries on 401 but during ephemeral refresh storms the control plane returned 403 for a short window. SDK treats 403 as terminal and doesn't refresh, so app-level retry kicks in and non-idempotent hooks might double-run. Filed a ticket with traces.
carl: two fixes: (1) accept snake_case aliases or canonicalize names at SDK boundary (and warn in dev builds); (2) document and unify retry semantics for 401 vs 403 around ephemeral token refresh.
nina: opened DEVEX-9990 with logs and a minimal failing test.
devex-bot: Created issue DEVEX-14001 from this thread and assigned to @carl.
carl: I'll add a small alias map in Go SDK and a unit test comparing SDK wire payload to direct REST. Also adding an e2e in sampleapp to assert no duplicate side-effects on auth races.
nina: thanks — please add a short README note for customers about app-level retries on non-idempotent endpoints. :white_check_mark:
